# Setup package

```{r}
targetPackages <- c('data.table',
                    'dplyr',
                    'flextable',
                    'janitor',
                    'ggbeeswarm',
                    'ggforce',
                    'gghighlight',
                    'ggplot2', 
                    'ggpubr',
                    'ggpmisc',
                    'ggrepel',
                    'gridExtra',
                    'gt',
                    'magrittr',
                    'mcr',        # Deming / Passing-Bablok 回帰
                    'mmtable2',
                    'officer',
                    'patchwork',
                    'plot3D',
                    'purrr',
                    'readxl',
                    'showtext',
                    'stringr',
                    'tibble',
                    'tidyr',
                    'zoo') 

newPackages <- targetPackages[!(targetPackages %in% 
                                  installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
if(length(newPackages))
  install.packages(newPackages, repos = "http://cran.us.r-project.org")
for(package in targetPackages)
  library(package, character.only = T)
options(scipen = 10000)
#windowsFonts(Meiryo = windowsFont("Meiryo")) 
#theme_set(theme_gray(base_family = "Meiryo"))
```

```{r}
#a1c.path <- "D:/R/data/immunoturbidimetry_data/a1c/2nd/std"
```

```{r}
item.lev <- paste0(seq(100, 130, by = 10), "% 2ndAb")
```

# graph

```{r}
a1c.ori <- a1c.acc[, !1:2] |>
  setnames(rep(c("delta", "initial"), time = length(a1cCal) * 2)) |>
  transform(
    item  = rep(item.lev,  length.out = nrow(a1c.acc)),
    item2 = if (exists("item2.lev")) rep(item2.lev, each = nrow(a1c.acc)/length(item2.lev), length.out = nrow(a1c.acc)) else NA
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(item, item2),
    names_to = "OD",
    values_to = "meas"
  ) |>
  transform(
    ID   = rep(1:2, each = 2),
    conc = rep(a1cCal, each = 4)
  ) |>
  filter(OD == "delta")

a1c.lab <- pivot_wider(a1c.ori,
                       id_cols = c("item", "item2", "conc"),
                       names_from = "ID", values_from = "meas")

num_cols <- a1c.lab |>
  select(matches("^\\d+$"))

a1c.lab <- a1c.lab |>
  mutate(mean = rowMeans(num_cols, na.rm = T)) |>
  filter(conc == max(a1cCal))


# plot
has_item2 <- any(!is.na(a1c.ori$item2))

a1c.std <- ggplot(a1c.ori, aes(conc, meas, color = item)) +
  geom_line(stat = "summary", fun = mean) +
  geom_text_repel(data = a1c.lab, aes(x = conc, y = mean, label = item), size = 3.5) +
  labs(x = "a1c(%)", y = "OD") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


#a1c.std <- a1c.std +
#  facet_wrap(.~lot)
# item2 があるときだけ facet を追加
if (has_item2) {
  a1cCf.std <- a1c.std + facet_wrap(~ item2)
}

a1c.std

# PDF出力
showtext_auto()

ggsave(
  filename = file.path("D:/R/PDF/HbA1c", file_name),
  plot = a1c.std,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  width = 11.7, height = 8.3, units = "in"
)

rm(list = ls()) #消去
```
